name: wine-notebook
description: Scale a tea recipe and compare your infusion notes.

interface.longDescription: Scale a tea recipe and compare your infusion notes. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Scale a supplied steeping recipe; Compare personal tea observations; Review repeated infusions. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring. Works only with supplied recipes and observations. No health or caffeine advice, purchases, live product lookup or background timers. Follow your equipment and ingredient instructions for safe preparation.
defaultPrompt: Help me scale a supplied steeping recipe.
Help me compare personal tea observations.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Tea Pages: Brew Notes workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Scale a supplied steeping recipe. Reproducible inputs: {"recipe_leaf_g":3,"recipe_water_ml":250,"desired_water_ml":600,"recipe_seconds":180}
positive.prompt: Help me scale a supplied steeping recipe with these supplied values: {"recipe_leaf_g":3,"recipe_water_ml":250,"desired_water_ml":600,"recipe_seconds":180}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses tea_notes_scale_steeping_recipe with the supplied inputs. Returns {"scale_factor":2.4,"leaf_g":7.2,"water_ml":600,"steep_seconds":180,"leaf_g_per_100ml":1.2,"note":"Leaf weight scales with water; steep time is retained from your recipe, not multiplied. No temperature or time recommendation is inferred."}. Shows the actual recipe result. Does not fabricate external data.
